title: T10 — Change control (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Change Control — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Change requests

No project change row is recorded for T10's retrospective window. The project's lifecycle was
recorded under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`: charter,
baseline, closure and the destructive close gate each carry an approved approval decided by an
approver distinct from the requester. The out-of-sequence closure is recorded as an accepted
issue (`U3-EXC-T10`), not as a change.

## Impact

The retrospective pass touches no code: it records the lifecycle the project already lived.
The acceptance it rests on — the §12 T10 gate — is proved by the named tests in the Phase-G
review; eight V1 findings remain open against T10 and are named, not waived.

## Decisions

| Decision | Gate | State |
|---|---|---|
| The charter of the rework | `charter` | approved, distinct approver |
| The frozen scope baseline | `baseline` | approved, distinct approver |
| The closure request | `closure` | approved, distinct approver |
| The destructive close | `projects.close` | approved, typed evidence = the closure asset |
